segs: I'm honestly really impressed with this camera.
It's completely wire-free, it rotates in every direction,
and it actually detects and tracks people as they move.
Plus, it has Zoom, which is way more useful than I expected.
And the best part?
You don't have to pay a monthly membership fee just to use it.
Installation is ridiculously easy.
You literally just pick a solid spot, put in two screws,
mount it, and you're done.
No drilling holes through walls,
no running power cables, none of that.
It also comes with a solar panel,
so it stays charged off sunlight,
and the cable is long enough that you can mount the camera
where it makes sense, like your front door or your garage,
but put the solar panel somewhere safer or sunnier
so it can keep the battery topped off.
Once it's set up, it kind of just runs,
and feature-wise, it's loaded.
Two-way talk, a spotlight, a siren, night vision,
and even full-color night video.
If you want to avoid subscriptions completely,
just pop in a microSD card and it stores recordings locally,
and you can watch everything right from your phone.
If you want a simple security setup
without the wiring headache,
this is an easy recommendation.
